title: Integer encoded by a bit list
statement: For a finite list of Boolean values, define its encoded natural number recursively: the empty list encodes $0$, and a list with first bit $b$ and remaining list $L$ encodes twice the number encoded by $L$, plus $1$ if $b$ is true and $0$ if $b$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of Boolean values
